text:
Samir: Quick async sync — planning to land the kernel GC -> eviction change tonight (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789). Main concern: eviction interacting with continuous batching might blow up p99. Asking owners: Lila (kernel) and Priya (batching) can you paste the perf numbers you have? Also we depend on eng-infra driver v2 — @Jo can you confirm compatibility and whether we should pin to a micro version?

Lila: looked at canary run on my dev cluster earlier. Median token latency down ~2ms, p95 steady, but p99 jumps ~+12ms when sequence lengths >1024 and KV hit-rate < 40%. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/runtime/d/evict-canary (filters: kernel-gc-evict). My quick patch used `evict_threshold_ms=500` which smooths spikes.

Priya: thanks. For continuous batching: if we start evicting more aggressively we see more cache-misses which forces earlier KV population and can lengthen batching windows. I pushed a tiny opt-in flag in the batching PR (https://github.com/redwood-inference/batching/pull/412) to avoid merging policy changes until after canary. Suggest rollout plan: 10% traffic for 2h during low-traffic window (after 18:00 PST). Can we also gate by seq_len < 1024?

Jo: infra check — driver v2 is compatible but there was a change in the memory allocator in v2.1 that affects page alignment. Recommend pinning to `driver-v2.1.3` for this canary. If you don't pin, you might see sporadic OOMs on certain instance families. I'll promote a driver image with `--page-align-fix` by EOD if you want.

Samir: good call. Lila/Priya, can you update PRs to add the pin and the canary rollout config? I'll schedule the canary at 18:15 PST if everyone agrees.

Lila: will update kernel PR tonight to include `driver: driver-v2.1.3` in the deployment manifest and add the `evict_threshold_ms` default. Code snippet to add to manifest:```yaml
containers:
  - name: kernel
    image: ghcr.io/redwood-inference/kernel:canary
    env:
      - name: DRIVER_VERSION
        value: "v2.1.3"
      - name: EVICT_THRESHOLD_MS
        value: "500"
```

Priya: I'll add the canary rollout config to batching plans and gate by `seq_len < 1024`. I'll also set `batching.eviction_safe_mode=true` for the first hour. PR link once done.

DevOps Bot: canary scheduled by @Samir for 2026-03-18T18:15:00-07:00. Canary percentage: 10%. Target route: /api/generate (kernel).

CI Bot: runtime PR #789 — CI: ✅ all checks passed (unit, integration, perf-smoke).

Jo: I'll build and push the driver image with `--page-align-fix`. Tag: `driver-v2.1.3-fix1`. ETA: 2 hours.

Samir: ok — plan: Lila lands kernel PR with driver pin + evict tweak, Priya lands batching gate + rollout config, Jo pushes driver image, we start canary 18:15 PST 10% for 2h. If p99 > baseline +20ms or error spike > 0.5% rollback immediately.

Priya: acked, will post PR link when ready. :thumbsup:

Lila: acked, will coordinate rollback runbook on the PR.

Samir: thanks all. If you see anything weird ping me in this thread and @eng-sre.
